audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Deuteronomy / Devarim Torah-guarding, Horeb revelation, anti-image, exile-return, and refuge-city discourse, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for addition/subtraction warning, Baal Peor memory, wisdom among nations, Horeb without form, anti-idolatry, exile and return, Divine uniqueness, cities of refuge, and Torah introduction.

verses.restored: Now, Israel, listen to statutes and judgments I teach you to do, so you may live and enter and possess land YHWH Divine of your fathers is giving you.

familiar.text: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you.

verses.restored: You shall not add to word I command you, and you shall not diminish from it, to keep commands of YHWH your Divine that I command you.

familiar.text: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.

verses.restored: Your eyes saw what YHWH did at Baal-peor, for every man who went after Baal-peor YHWH your Divine destroyed from your midst.

familiar.text: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baalpeor: for all the men that followed Baalpeor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.

verses.restored: But you who clung to YHWH your Divine are all alive today.

familiar.text: But ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God are alive every one of you this day.

verses.restored: See, I have taught you statutes and judgments as YHWH my Divine commanded me, to do thus in midst of land where you are entering to possess it.

familiar.text: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.

verses.restored: Keep and do them, for this is your wisdom and understanding before eyes of peoples who hear all these statutes and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.

familiar.text: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.

verses.restored: For what great nation has a divine near to it as YHWH our Divine whenever we call to him?

familiar.text: For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the LORD our God is in all things that we call upon him for?

verses.restored: And what great nation has righteous statutes and judgments like all this Torah/instruction I set before you today?

familiar.text: And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?

verses.restored: Only guard yourself and guard your soul/life greatly, lest you forget things your eyes saw and lest they depart from your heart all days of your life; make them known to your children and your children's children.

familiar.text: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons’ sons;

verses.restored: The day you stood before YHWH your Divine at Horeb, when YHWH said to me, Assemble people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear/revere me all days they live on ground and may teach their children.

familiar.text: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.

verses.restored: You drew near and stood below mountain, and mountain burned with fire to heart of heavens, darkness, cloud, and thick gloom.

familiar.text: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to you from midst of fire; voice of words you heard, but form you did not see—only voice.

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.

verses.restored: He declared to you his covenant that he commanded you to do, ten words, and wrote them on two tablets of stone.

familiar.text: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.

verses.restored: YHWH commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments for you to do in land where you are crossing to possess it.

familiar.text: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.

verses.restored: Guard your souls/lives greatly, for you saw no form on day YHWH spoke to you at Horeb from midst of fire,

familiar.text: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the LORD spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:

familiar.text: Lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

familiar.text: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:

familiar.text: But the LORD hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as ye are this day.

verses.restored: YHWH was angry with me because of your words and swore I would not cross Jordan and not enter good land YHWH your Divine is giving you as inheritance.

familiar.text: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance:

familiar.text: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.

verses.restored: Guard yourselves lest you forget covenant of YHWH your Divine that he cut with you and make for yourselves carved image, likeness of anything YHWH your Divine commanded you against.

familiar.text: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.

verses.restored: For YHWH your Divine is consuming fire, a jealous Divine.

familiar.text: For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.

verses.restored: When you father children and children's children and grow old in land, and act corruptly and make carved image, form of anything, and do evil in eyes of YHWH your Divine to provoke him,

verses.restored: I call heavens and earth as witnesses against you today that you shall surely perish quickly from land you cross Jordan to possess; you shall not lengthen days upon it, but shall surely be destroyed.

familiar.text: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.

verses.restored: YHWH will scatter you among peoples, and you shall remain few in number among nations where YHWH drives you.

familiar.text: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the LORD shall lead you.

verses.restored: There you shall serve gods, work of human hands, wood and stone, which do not see or hear or eat or smell.

familiar.text: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

verses.restored: But from there you shall seek YHWH your Divine, and you shall find, when you seek him with all your heart and all your soul/life.

familiar.text: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.

verses.restored: In your distress, when all these words find you in latter days, you shall return to YHWH your Divine and listen to his voice.

familiar.text: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days, if thou turn to the LORD thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;

verses.restored: For a compassionate Divine is YHWH your Divine; he will not abandon you or destroy you or forget covenant of your fathers that he swore to them.

familiar.text: (For the LORD thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.

verses.restored: Or has a divine attempted to come take for itself a nation from midst of nation, by trials, signs, wonders, war, strong hand, outstretched arm, and great terrors, according to all YHWH your Divine did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

familiar.text: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

verses.restored: You were shown to know that YHWH, he is Divine; there is none besides him.

familiar.text: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the LORD he is God; there is none else beside him.

verses.restored: From heavens he made you hear his voice to discipline/instruct you, and upon earth he showed you his great fire, and his words you heard from midst of fire.

familiar.text: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.

verses.restored: Because he loved your fathers and chose their seed after them, he brought you out from Egypt by his presence and great power,

familiar.text: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;

familiar.text: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.

familiar.text: Know therefore this day, and consider it in thine heart, that the LORD he is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.

verses.restored: Keep his statutes and commands that I command you today, so it may be well with you and your children after you, and so you may lengthen days upon ground YHWH your Divine gives you all days.

translation_notes: Horeb revelation is emphatically a heard voice without visible form; anti-image language protects Divine transcendence but must not justify destruction of other people's art or sacred sites.
Israel's Torah is presented as wisdom visible to nations, not as permission for ethnic supremacy.
The exile warning ends in return, seeking, compassion, and covenant memory—not permanent rejection.
Claims of Divine uniqueness and Israel's election remain Jewish covenant language and must not be superseded by later communities.
Verse 38's dispossession language remains morally contested and cannot authorize modern territorial violence.
The cities of refuge insert life-preserving asylum into the chapter's covenant exhortation.
safety_note: Do not use Deuteronomy 4 to justify iconoclasm, forced conversion, antisemitism, supersessionism, colonial dispossession, or blaming exiled and traumatized peoples for their suffering. Center memory, compassionate return, Torah wisdom, and refuge from revenge.
